label: DESI/DESI DR1 z-catalog (US-East, S3)
name: Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 1 (z-catalog)
description: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) is a 5-year spectroscopic redshift survey designed to map the three-dimensional structure of the universe between z=0 and z=4. Data Release 1 includes high-confidence redshifts for 18.7 million objects - 13.1 million galaxies, 1.6 million quasars, and 4 million stars - from observations taken between May 2021 and June 2022.
